ground_truth.cause: In batch, session-indexer writes another MiB each minute into /cache/data on a memory-backed emptyDir. It has no retention bound, a 96Mi container limit and a 256Mi volume limit. The cache growth can eventually exhaust the container budget.
ground_truth.impact: The growing cache is contained to this batch worker. Its latency and timeout log messages are scripted; they do not establish real downstream request degradation.
ground_truth.mitigation: Bound cache size/retention and reclaim or evict obsolete entries, or stop the worker as containment. Restarting or raising the limit alone does not remove the unbounded growth. Verify the memory/cache trend stabilizes over time.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
